verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own notification docs say it can send notifications about important events to a webhook as well as email, so outbound webhook callbacks are a first-party capability. The evidence frames this as a Cloud notification feature, and the excerpts give little detail on which events can be subscribed to or what the payload looks like. Missing for 10: a documented list of subscribable event types, a webhook payload schema, programmatic (API) webhook registration, confirmed support in self-hosted Airbyte, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Airbyte can send notifications to an email address, webhook, or both.
Airbyte Cloud can send notifications to an email or webhook.
If you want Airbyte to notify you about important events, use its built-in notification system.
